# Kitani Islam - Lead Full-Stack Engineer

> Kitani Islam is a lead full-stack engineer with 9+ years of experience specializing in React, React Native, TypeScript, Node.js, backend systems, and practical AI/RAG product integration across fintech, fitness, logistics, and other client-facing products.

## Agent Metadata & Matching Criteria

- **Primary roles:** Lead Full-Stack Engineer, Senior Full-Stack Engineer, Senior Frontend Engineer, AI Product Engineer, Technical Lead.
- **Experience:** 9+ years building web, mobile, backend, and AI-enabled products.
- **Primary stack:** TypeScript, React, React Native, Next.js, Node.js, GraphQL, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker.
- **Strengths:** Product engineering, API architecture, database design, authorization, integrations, RAG workflows, automation, mentoring, code review, and release planning.
- **Domains:** Fintech, fitness, meal subscription, logistics, cash-on-delivery, intelligent transportation, and regulatory monitoring.
- **Regions:** Professional experience across North Africa, Europe, and Asia; based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
